title: How is Adolf Hitler connected to Albert Einstein?
description: A British prime minister, Winston Churchill and Charlie Chaplin connect Adolf Hitler to Albert Einstein.
hook: How is Adolf Hitler connected to Albert Einstein?
fun_fact: After his 1936 visit, Lloyd George wrote in the Daily Express that Hitler was 'the George Washington of Germany'.
research_note: Einstein did visit Churchill at Chartwell in 1933, but no photo of the two together is known, so the route runs through Chaplin, who met both men.

image.credit: US National Archives (NARA), via US Holocaust Memorial Museum

links.line: In 1936, Britain's old wartime prime minister, David Lloyd George, visited Hitler at his mountain home.
In 1907, Lloyd George and a young Winston Churchill were so close they were nicknamed the Terrible Twins.
In 1929, Churchill dropped by Hollywood to watch Charlie Chaplin film City Lights.

image.file: File:Albert Einstein and Charlie Chaplin City Lights premiere 1931.jpg

links.line: In 1931, Albert Einstein joined him for its opening night.
